_note: P5 scenarios (v2.36). A separate file, run with `run.py --scenario-file vehicle/p5_scenarios.json`, so scenarios/scenarios.json and the CI baseline are untouched. Cold start to 20 km/h, then the command stream is lost at 4.5 s. P5-01: lost for good. P5-01L: lost for 300 ms and then back (a new scenario, not SC-15, which is 200 ms); a controller that does not latch resumes driving, so it is the control for the no_latch bug. duration_ms is long enough for the long_timeout bug (which stops about 1.2 s later) to finish its stop.
